# TP-Link TL-MR3020 V3.30: archived support-page summary

Captured 2026-11-09. This is a project-maintained summary, not the complete vendor page.

- [Original English page](https://www.tp-link.com/en/support/download/tl-mr3020/v3.30/) · [saved English HTML](tp-link-mr3020-v3.30-en.html).
- Listed firmware: **TL-MR3020(EU)_V3.30_250625**; publication date **2025-07-14**, multi-language, displayed size **6.81 MB**. The release note describes improved device stability.
- [Original firmware ZIP](https://static.tp-link.com/upload/firmware/2025/202507/20250714/TL-MR3020_3.0_1.7.0%20Build%20250625.zip) · [unaltered local ZIP](tl-mr3020-eu-v3.30-250625.zip).
- Match the device hardware version and purchase region before upgrading. Keep power connected and prefer Ethernet during the upgrade. Extract the downloaded archive first.

The vendor page describes ordinary firmware updates; it does not document our bootloader-recovery transformation. The ZIP includes the original BIN, upgrade instructions and GPL terms. Despite the ZIP name containing 1.7.0, its BIN identifies 1.8.0; the repository pins bytes by SHA256.

The Russian-region URL returned HTTP 404. A supplementary [Russian-language Kazakhstan page](https://www.tp-link.com/kz/support/download/tl-mr3020/v3.30/) was available and was [saved separately](tp-link-mr3020-v3.30-ru-kz.html). It lists the same release. [Russian translation of this summary](support.md).

If the site disappears, use the saved HTML, original ZIP and [provenance/hash manifest](manifest.json). HTML snapshots preserve response bodies, not external styles, scripts or images; offline layout may differ. They are archival evidence, not executable recovery instructions.
